name: ArchiveFootageClearanceDesk
tagline: Request, clear, license and log every archive clip in the cut – before the E&O insurer asks.
description: Complete archive and stock footage clearance app for documentaries, factual series, news and branded content: clip requests, clearance pipeline, clearance matrix for copyright, people releases, music and logos, rights coverage against the production's territory, media and term, rate-card fees, archive budgets per production and a usage log that compares seconds used with seconds licensed.
features: E&O risk KPIs (used but unlicensed, over-usage, rights gaps)
Rate-card fee calculation with minimum billable seconds
Archive budget per production with executive sign-off
Drag & drop pipeline with business rules
Bulk advance / copyright cleared / drop / export
Demo mode with fictional sample data
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
